package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/onboardinghandoff"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const maximumOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestBytes int64 = 16 << 10

type OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler struct{ Accept onboardinghandoff.Acceptor }

type onboardingPlanHandoffPayload struct {
	Schema           string          `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedStateRef json.RawMessage `json:"expected_state_ref"`
	DialogID         string          `json:"dialog_id"`
	TeacherJobID     string          `json:"teacher_job_id"`
}

func (handler OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler) AcceptStudent(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	if !domain.ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(studentID) {
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	idempotencyValues := request.Header.Values("Idempotency-Key")
	if len(idempotencyValues) != 1 || !domain.ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(idempotencyValues[0]) {
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_idempotency_key")
		return
	}
	idempotencyKey := idempotencyValues[0]
	contentType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(request.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || contentType != "application/json" {
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	payload, err := decodeOnboardingPlanHandoffPayload(writer, request)
	if err != nil {
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	response, created, err := handler.Accept.Handle(request.Context(), onboardinghandoff.AcceptInput{
		StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,
		Request: domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest{
			Schema: payload.Schema, ExpectedStateRef: payload.ExpectedStateRef,
			DialogID: payload.DialogID, TeacherJobID: payload.TeacherJobID,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffDomainError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writeOnboardingPlanHandoffJSON(writer, status, response)
}

func decodeOnboardingPlanHandoffPayload(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) (struct {
	Schema           string
	ExpectedStateRef domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
	DialogID         string
	TeacherJobID     string
}, error) {
	var payload onboardingPlanHandoffPayload
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, maximumOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestBytes))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return struct {
			Schema           string
			ExpectedStateRef domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
			DialogID         string
			TeacherJobID     string
		}{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || payload.ExpectedStateRef == nil || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(payload.ExpectedStateRef), []byte("null")) {
		return struct {
			Schema           string
			ExpectedStateRef domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
			DialogID         string
			TeacherJobID     string
		}{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var expected domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
	expectedDecoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload.ExpectedStateRef))
	expectedDecoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := expectedDecoder.Decode(&expected); err != nil || expectedDecoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return struct {
			Schema           string
			ExpectedStateRef domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
			DialogID         string
			TeacherJobID     string
		}{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return struct {
		Schema           string
		ExpectedStateRef domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
		DialogID         string
		TeacherJobID     string
	}{Schema: payload.Schema, ExpectedStateRef: expected, DialogID: payload.DialogID, TeacherJobID: payload.TeacherJobID}, nil
}

func writeOnboardingPlanHandoffDomainError(writer http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "capability_disabled")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStateChanged):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusConflict, "state_changed")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrActivePathExists):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusConflict, "active_path_exists")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotReady):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "not_ready")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusBadGateway, "student_state_unavailable")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrGoalGraphUnavailable):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "published_graph_unavailable")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrGoalGraphInvalid):
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "published_graph_invalid")
	default:
		writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
	}
}

func writeOnboardingPlanHandoffError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	writeOnboardingPlanHandoffJSON(writer, status, map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}

func writeOnboardingPlanHandoffJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(payload)
}
